item.title: Implement BFF using Auth0, Angular and ASP.NET Core
item.description: This post should how to implement a web application which needs secure access and secure identities. The application uses Angular as the UI tech, ASP.NET Core as the backend tech and a backend for frontend security architecture using OpenID Connect, OAuth and Auth0 as the identity provider.
